LanguageData.FGP.RichText.Tip: The engine's own elision rules stop at a markup tag. This applies them across it.
LanguageData.FGP.AspiratedH.Tip: Words with an aspirated h keep their article. Word list in Data/aspirated-h.txt.
LanguageData.FGP.Possessive.Tip: "sa epee" becomes "son epee". The engine does not do this at all.
LanguageData.FGP.KindGender.Tip: A species noun keeps its own gender whatever the sex of the animal. Word list in Data/pawnkind-gender.txt.
LanguageData.FGP.Typography.Tip: Before : ; ! and ?. Off by default because not every font has the narrow no-break space.
LanguageData.FGP.Verbose.Tip: Logs what was patched and every gender override. For bug reports.
LanguageData.FGP.DataFiles: Both word lists are plain text files in the mod's Data folder. Edit without recompiling; restart the game to reload.
